"We evolve beyond the person that we were a minute before. Little by little, we advance a bit further with each turn. That's how a drill works!"

Simon the digger is the main protagonist of Gurren Lagann. He started out as a short and unassuming lonely boy, but thanks to Kamina's motivation and the discovery of his mech, Lagann, he grew to become the hero of his entire universe. He regularly overcomes impossible odds and always pushes himself to new heights. He is stubborn, but both creative and reactive - he's able to adapt to and overcome any obstacle in his way, and even learns from the villains he fights.

Though he is stubborn, he is also a kind, polite, compassionate figure. He cares for his friends and loved ones dearly. At the start of his journey, he only had his bro, Kamina. Later, he would gain more friends and allies, including his beloved fiancee Nia Teppelin.

In SPNATI, Simon brings over a lot of the same hot-blooded energy and dynamic, loud-voiced strength you would expect from a shonen protagonist. Unlike his bro Kamina, however, he is a lot less more crudely perverted and a bit more articulate when it comes to expressing appreciation or interest.

Targetable qualities:
- He is a mecha pilot. Specifically, he pilots a head-shaped gunmen (robot) the size of a small car called Lagann, which has the unique ability to combine with other gunmen to form a larger one - with Kamina's 'Gurren', they are able to form 'Gurren Lagann'. Later in the series, it is revealed that Simon's 'Spiral Power' - literally heroic willpower made manifest - is channelled through Lagann and this allows him to achieve increasingly incredible feats of power.
- He is the leader of Team Dai-Gurren, a resistance force that overthrew the Spiral King, Lordgenome, and saved humanity from being imprisoned underground. As the leader of the resistance, he was then appointed Supreme Commander of the new earth government, a position he wasn't exactly excellent at, but ultimately had everyone's best interests at heart even when people turned against him.
- He has been to space and fought a war against a being known as the Anti Spiral. He fought the moon and won. (The moon was a giant gunmen/mecha.)
- But, at the same time, he started out in the dirt, a humble tunnel digger for his village. Kept underground by forces then-unknown (the Beastmen), his village was constantly under threat of collapse due to earthquakes (caused by those same Beastmen landing their gunmen up on the surface).
